details:
Q1: What should be improved?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow or pipeline phase — include the workflow/phase name and current problem (RECOMMENDED)
B. Documentation or README content — include the page/topic to improve
C. Tests, validation, or CI reliability — include the failing check/log or flaky behavior
Q2: What outcome should define success?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug/regression — provide observed vs expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Reduce operational noise, cost, or flakiness — provide the signal/metric to improve
C. Add or change a capability — describe the expected new behavior
